title: High-Performance Protocol for ONT Library Preparation
author: Lukas Žemaitis
materials: Perform a quality check using MinKNOW software.

steps.title: Transfer DNA to PCR tube
steps.instruction: Transfer 250 fmol of double‑stranded DNA into a clean 0.2 mL PCR tube, adjusting the volume according to the DNA concentration.

steps.title: Add ligation reagents and mix
steps.instruction: Add the following components in the specified order, pipetting ~10 times after each addition:

substeps.instruction: 10 µL Quick T4 DNA Ligase (E6056S, NEB)

steps.title: Centrifuge and load into thermal cycler
steps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge the tube and place it into a thermal cycler with a heated lid.

steps.title: Run thermal program
steps.instruction: Program the cycler for 20 °C for 5 minutes followed by 65 °C for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer reaction to low‑bind tube
steps.instruction: After incubation, transfer the reaction mixture to a 1.5 mL RNase‑ and DNase‑free low‑bind tube.

steps.title: Incubate ligation at room temperature
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction at room temperature for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Add AMPure XP beads and mix
steps.instruction: Add 180 µL AMPure XP beads (AXP, ONT) for 100 bp fragments, then invert the tube for 5 minutes to mix.

steps.title: Magnetic bead separation
steps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge the tube, then place it on a magnetic rack for 3 minutes to pellet the beads.

steps.title: First SFB wash
steps.instruction: While the tube remains on the magnet, add 250 µL Small Fragment Buffer (SFB, ONT) and carefully remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Second SFB wash
steps.instruction: Remove the tube from the magnet, gently rotate for at least 3 minutes (occasionally flicking), briefly centrifuge, place back on the magnet for 3 minutes, then remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Final wash and supernatant removal
steps.instruction: Repeat the wash with another 250 µL SFB using the same procedure, then briefly centrifuge, place on the magnet to remove any remaining supernatant.

steps.title: Dry bead pellet
steps.instruction: Allow the bead pellet to air‑dry for 1 minute before removing the tube from the magnet.

steps.title: Elute library DNA
steps.instruction: Add 12 µL Elution Buffer (EB, ONT) to the tube and mix thoroughly by pipetting.

steps.title: Collect eluate and keep on ice
steps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes, then place the tube back on the magnet for 3 minutes, transfer the supernatant (prepared library) to a new 1.5 mL RNase‑ and DNase‑free tube, and keep on ice.

steps.title: Quantify library with Qubit
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration using the Qubit HS dsDNA kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

steps.title: Insert Flongle flow cell
steps.instruction: Insert a Flongle flow cell (ONT) into a MinION Mk1B device (ONT).

steps.title: Pre‑run incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the device at room temperature for 10 minutes before initiating the sequencing run.

steps.title: Verify active pores
steps.instruction: Select only flow cells that have ≥ 50 active pores for sequencing.

steps.title: Prepare priming mix on ice
steps.instruction: In a 1.5 mL tube, combine the specified flow‑cell priming mix components (as listed in the original protocol) and keep the tube on ice.

steps.title: Open flow cell port
steps.instruction: Peel back the seal tab of the Flongle flow cell to expose the sample port.

steps.title: Secure flow cell seal
steps.instruction: Adhere the seal tab to the MinION lid using its adhesive strip.

steps.title: Load priming mix into flow cell
steps.instruction: Carefully load the priming mix into the flow cell, ensuring no air bubbles are introduced.

steps.title: Incubate flow cell
steps.instruction: Incubate the flow cell for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare sequencing mix
steps.instruction: During the incubation, combine the sequencing mix components as specified in the original protocol.
